editorial_requirements: Use current GMC medical student guidance and Good medical practice 2024. Use GDC guidance if any dental scenario is included.
Create seven distinct scenario fingerprints and avoid close semantic matches to live practice, timed, or other batch units.
Use accessible context with clear actor role, authority, urgency, patient or service impact, and reasonable alternatives.
Do not generate Most/Least items or force rating variety within a scenario. Distinguish adjacent rating choices in each rationale.
